## Activity

During July 2021, East City Eye Clinic completed 128 captures. Activity proceeded in line with the planned service arrangements, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available information indicates that routine leave was managed without a reported disruption to capture activity. The site continued to provide screening activity throughout the month, with completed captures available for image-quality review and grading.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 4 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.1. The ungradable images were excluded from reliable grading, while the remaining images proceeded through the usual assessment process. Image-quality outcomes should continue to be monitored through routine site review, particularly where repeat capture or further operational support may be required.

## Grading

Grading identified 29 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This provides a summary measure of the time taken for images to move through the grading process during July 2021. The results should be considered alongside the image-quality findings and the site’s activity during the reporting period.
